name: ygl-trees
description: Research workbench CLI for AI agents — evidence-first research pipeline, claims calibration and tech-tree skill modeling (SQLite; 猿光·科技树)

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json && pnpm build:bundle:only && pnpm --filter @ygl/web build && node scripts/stage-web-dist.mjs
scripts.build:bundle:only: tsdown apps/cli/src/bin.ts --format cjs --out-dir dist/bundle --platform node --target node20 --deps.never-bundle better-sqlite3 --deps.never-bundle node-sqlite3-wasm --deps.never-bundle typeorm --deps.never-bundle reflect-metadata --deps.never-bundle pg --deps.never-bundle @deepseek-ai/dsh-atomic-write
scripts.test: pnpm build && pnpm test:unit && bash examples/demo.sh && bash scripts/contract-audit.sh && pnpm ratchet
scripts.prepublishOnly: node scripts/prepublish-guard.mjs && pnpm test && pnpm pack:check
